newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Mauritius index ends rising sessions.
newsitem.headline: Mauritius index ends rising sessions.

text.p: The Mauritius bourse index Semdex ended 17 consecutive trading sessions of upward movement on Monday, shedding 0.81 points to close at 362.96, bourse officials said.
Volume totalled 8.24 million rupees on 461,504 shares from 16.11 million rupees on 732,884 shares last Friday.
The end of the bull run on the Semdex was seen as a natural cycle of the market.
"It was bound to happen. You must not forget that the Semdex had not lost ground since the start of December," one broker said.
"But what is worth noticing is that several stocks continued to rise and the Semdex was dragged down only by receding share prices of Sun Resorts and Swan Insurance."
Sun Resort lost 1.80 rupees to 38 on 9,077 shares while Swan Insurance dropped 2.90 rupees to 45.10 on 2,335 shares after it surged forward by 2.50 rupees last Friday.
